analysis.reason: 최근 5거래일 연속 하락(-4.40%, -3.27%, -0.40%, -1.20%, -2.38%)으로 RSI 31.7까지 하락하며 과매도 구간 진입. MACD 히스토그램은 2.3545에서 -2.4069로 악화되며 약세 지속. ADX 24.8로 추세 형성 초기 단계이나, -DI(37.2)가 +DI(15.4)를 크게 상회하며 하락 압력 우위. 주봉상 SMA20/SMA100 하회하며 장기 추세 약화. 현재가 $570.00은 스윙 지지선 $557.01에 근접하나, 하락 모멘텀이 강해 추가 하락 가능성 상존. 따라서 관망 유지.
analysis.reasonEn: Consecutive declines over the last 5 trading days (-4.40%, -3.27%, -0.40%, -1.20%, -2.38%) have pushed RSI down to 31.7, entering oversold territory. The MACD histogram has worsened from 2.3545 to -2.4069, indicating continued weakness. ADX is at 24.8, in the early stages of trend formation, but the -DI (37.2) significantly exceeds the +DI (15.4), showing a downward pressure advantage. Weekly SMAs (20/100) are breached, weakening the long-term trend. The current price of $570.00 is near the swing support of $557.01, but the strong downward momentum suggests potential for further decline. Therefore, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.

· 스윙 저항선 ($605.81): 단기 반등 시 첫 저항 구간, 돌파 여부 중요

[거래량·결론]

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($570.00) vs SMA5 ($605.58)/SMA20 ($619.02)/SMA50 ($676.78): Below short/mid-term trends, confirming weak zone.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($638.61)/SMA200 ($627.94): Below long-term trends, continued selling pressure.
· 52-week position (19.2%) + Current price near historical lows, indicating a critical juncture.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (47.8→31.7): Entered oversold territory, confirming strengthening downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (2.3545→-2.4069): Continued weakness, maintaining selling pressure after a death cross.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $586.20): Approaching lower band, suggesting potential for further decline.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($557.01): Close to Pivot S1 ($541.83), forming a key support zone.
· Swing resistance ($605.81): First resistance zone on short-term bounces, breakthrough is crucial.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Lower High formation): Continued downtrend, weak recovery signals.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.97x): Moderate confidence in price movement, need to confirm accompanying trend change.
· Current phase diagnosis (Downtrend): Potential for further decline remains, buy entry only after recovery of swing support ($557.01) and confirmation of 5-day/20-day high pattern reversal.
